title: Kenyan Fluffy Pancakes
description: A sweet and fluffy pancake recipe inspired by Kenyan cuisine, made with jazzy milk and topped with fluffy pancakes.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together kenyan, fluffy, and milk until well combined.
Add jazzy and mix until smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Drop 1/4 cup of the batter onto the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve with additional fluffy pancakes on top.
